title: Runtime Assured Autonomy
solicitation_objective: Develop runtime assured autonomy functions that monitor black-box autonomy outputs, determine when COAs are infeasible, incorrect, or non-optimal, and activate mitigation or reversionary behaviors.
source_basis: DAF 26.BZ Release 1 Phase I topic language, pp. 14-17.
opening_angle: black-box autonomy fault monitor; trust/health/proof layer; mitigation-supervisor hooks
delivery: Rust/C++ onboard software package plus interface specification, replay/evaluation tooling, and signed evidence artifacts for runtime trust assessment.
short_pitch: RTVLAS adapted as a black-box runtime assurance module that monitors autonomy outputs, detects infeasible or degraded decisions, and exports signed evidence for recovery and certification support.
phase2_transition: Integrate with surrogate UAS mission software aligned to A-GRA, port to companion compute targets, and demonstrate real-time mitigation hooks in SIL/HIL environments.
